care_requests_start_time_slot.name: care_requests_start_time_slot
care_requests_start_time_slot.value: "care_requests"."start_time" BETWEEN '18:00' AND '23:00' AND date_part('minute', "care_requests"."start_time") IN (0, 30) AND date_part('second', "care_requests"."start_time") = 0

care_requests_baby_age_range.name: care_requests_baby_age_range
care_requests_baby_age_range.value: ("care_requests"."baby_age_unit" = 'semaines' AND "care_requests"."baby_age_value" BETWEEN 0 AND 12) OR ("care_requests"."baby_age_unit" = 'mois' AND "care_requests"."baby_age_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 24)

care_requests_priority_sent_at.name: care_requests_priority_sent_at
care_requests_priority_sent_at.value: "care_requests"."priority_profile_id" IS NULL OR "care_requests"."priority_sent_at" IS NOT NULL

messages_body_length.name: messages_body_length
messages_body_length.value: "messages"."body" IS NULL OR char_length("messages"."body") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

payments_refunded.name: payments_refunded
payments_refunded.value: "payments"."status" NOT IN ('remboursee', 'remboursement_echoue') OR "payments"."refunded_at" IS NOT NULL
